claims.statement: For every joint limit p down to zero and q to 1/4, R/p = 8(q-1/4)^2 log2(1/p) + 1 - 1/(2 ln 2) + o(1), and a favorable open collar exists. No repair was required.
An effective uniform join covering the rest of p<1/64 and q outside the local collar is not proved; 0.49<p<=1/2 also remains outside the repaired certificate.
The two-bit helper has not been transported through arbitrary reused-coordinate hierarchies with every influence and terminal term charged once.
This is not an end-to-end universal GU review or a proof of FEI.
